tex_content.html:
Lemma
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0104 1. Lemma 3.31\group harmonic-coordinates

If a metric or tensor is $C^{k,\alpha }$ or $C^\infty $ in one chart, then it has the same regularity in harmonic coordinates.
